description: Summary figure: catalytic geometry, pairwise identity, within-genus constraint asymmetry, presequence character, and subfamily-diagnostic pocket residues
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d=json.load(open("seqs.json")); SEQ=d["SEQ"]
diag=pd.read_csv("pocket_diagnostic.csv"); ra=pd.read_csv("rate_asymmetry.csv"); ntd=pd.read_csv("nterm_features.csv")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1,1,1.15],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.28)

# A: triad / oxyanion distances
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
labs=["Hsa ABHD11","Cel abhd-11.2","Cel abhd-11.1"]
serhis=[3.19,3.59,2.93]; hisasp=[2.72,4.13,2.72]; oxy=[3.10,2.89,3.05]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.26
ax.bar(x-w,serhis,w,label="Ser OG - His NE2",color="#4C72B0")
ax.bar(x,hisasp,w,label="His ND1 - Asp O",color="#DD8452")
ax.bar(x+w,oxy,w,label="Ser OG - Ser+1 backbone N",color="#55A868")
ax.axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1); ax.text(2.45,3.57,"3.5 A",fontsize=7,color="grey",ha="right")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=8); ax.set_ylabel("distance (A)")
ax.set_title("a  Catalytic geometry in AlphaFold models",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=7,frameon=False)

# B: identity to human and to each other
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
vals=[39.6,32.5,41.3]; names=["abhd-11.2\nvs human","abhd-11.1\nvs human","abhd-11.2 vs\nabhd-11.1"]
ax.bar(names,vals,color=["#4C72B0","#C44E52","#8172B3"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+0.7,f"{v}%",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("% amino-acid identity"); ax.set_ylim(0,50)
ax.set_title("b  Pairwise identity (NW, BLOSUM62)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# C: rate asymmetry
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
for _,r in ra.iterrows():
    ax.plot([0,1],[r.abhd11_2_SF4_pid,r.abhd11_1_SF3_pid],"-o",color="#555",ms=5)
    ax.annotate(r.species_vs_Cel,(1.03,r.abhd11_1_SF3_pid),fontsize=7,va="center")
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["abhd-11.2 (SF4)","abhd-11.1 (SF3)"],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-0.25,1.35); ax.set_ylabel("% identity to C. elegans copy")
ax.set_title("c  Within-genus constraint, matched species pairs\n(paired t p = 0.0021, mean difference 7.8 pp)",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# D: N-terminal presequence
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
sub=ntd[ntd.protein.str.contains("Cel|Hsa")]
idx=np.arange(len(sub)); 
ax.barh(idx-0.2,sub.net_charge,0.38,label="net charge (1-40)",color="#4C72B0")
ax.barh(idx+0.2,sub.first_acidic_pos,0.38,label="position of first D/E",color="#C44E52")
ax.set_yticks(idx); ax.set_yticklabels([p.replace("_SF4","").replace("_SF3","") for p in sub.protein],fontsize=8)
ax.legend(fontsize=7,frameon=False); ax.set_xlabel("value")
ax.set_title("d  N-terminal presequence character",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# E: diagnostic pocket residues
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:])
dd=diag.sort_values("dist_A")
cols=["#C44E52" if t else "#CCCCCC" for t in dd.diagnostic]
ax.bar(range(len(dd)),dd.dist_A,color=cols)
lab=[f"{r.hsa}{r.hsa_pos}\n{r.SF4_consensus}/{r.SF3_consensus}" for _,r in dd.iterrows()]
ax.set_xticks(range(len(dd))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=6.5)
ax.set_ylabel("min distance to Ser132 OG (A)")
ax.set_title("e  Catalytic-pocket positions (human numbering), SF4 / SF3 consensus below each.\n"
             "Red = fully subfamily-diagnostic across 5 Caenorhabditis species; grey = shared",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.show()
